limitations: Performance figures are single observations on one macOS host, not qualification.
The dependency review is close reading plus differential testing, not a formal cryptographic or constant-time audit (inputs are public).
Upstream repository, commit and maintainer relationships were not verified (offline).
No non-macOS target was built; the absence of target dependencies rests on cargo tree --target all, metadata and cfg-free source.
Codex subject01 receipts were inspected, not re-executed; subject03 behaviour is established by the reviewer's own runs.
Probe expectations are reviewer-authored; the successor strictness probes encode the claimed new verifier behaviour.
Architecture documents were not reread beyond the cited passages.
